Tooltip_LPBCS_StylePlank: A slat of wood nailed to the front. Reads from across the room.
Tooltip_LPBCS_StylePaper: A sheet stuck to the front. Quick and unfussy.
Tooltip_LPBCS_StylePainted: Painted onto the wood itself, in the colour of the can you use. Needs a paintbrush and paint.
Tooltip_LPBCS_Side: Which face of the container the sign hangs on.
Tooltip_LPBCS_SideAuto: Leaves the choice to the mod: the right-hand face, unless a wall or a crate blocks it — the sign then moves round on its own.
Tooltip_LPBCS_SideLeft: Nails the sign to the left-hand face and leaves it there, even if the right one clears.
Tooltip_LPBCS_SideRight: Nails the sign to the right-hand face and leaves it there, even if something comes to stand against it.
